source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 53 native observations; 52 accepted full-LCD/status key replays. One mixed-number error-return caret retained referenceOnly. Saved directly to project.

MathI mixed numbers require two leading pixels of padding with the existing native glyphs. Positive/negative, improper numerator, empty template, zero integer and zero denominator/repair were measured.

SHIFT multiply on PLUS opens Absolute Value, not Recurring Decimal. Native 1|2| returns 2; 0.|9| returns 0. Originally recurring-labelled shortcut probes were renamed to observed Abs actions. Base-N ignores this shortcut.

Actual recurring input uses MathI CATALOG Numeric Calc item 4. Decimal prefix is required: bare recurring and integer prefix give Syntax ERROR; 0.(3), 1.2(3), 0.(12) and 0.(9) return 1/3, 37/30, 4/33 and 1. Plus/dot inside the recurring field are ignored; DEL and Undo restore the digit; RIGHT exits so +1 yields 4/3.
LineI Numeric Calc omits Recurring Decimal, shifting Int/Rnd/Intg to 4/5/6. Menu beginning/end, Int(-2.7), Abs(-7), and ignored mixed-fraction shortcut were observed.

2026-11-20 beta.85: zero-denominator mixed-number Back observation reactivated with original keys/pixels/statuses after independent root/radical/exponent/empty-slot controls. General Math ERROR Goto promotes the mixed node just like the existing fraction case.
